title: Kirak model
description: One model: its database table, fields and who may call each operation. The value of one key in models.json, or the whole content of one file in a models/ directory (the file name is the model name).

$schema.description: Points editors at this schema. Kirak ignores it when loading.

table.description: Database table name. A plain SQL identifier: letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit.

schema.description: The model's fields, by name. id, created_at, updated_at and deleted_at are added by Kirak and must not be listed.

internal.description: When true, no CRUD routes are generated. The table still exists; use it for tables that must not be exposed over HTTP. Default false.

soft_delete.description: When true, delete sets deleted_at instead of removing the row, and every read excludes deleted rows. Default false.

id_type.description: Type of the id primary key: an auto-increment integer, or a UUID Kirak generates (CHAR(36)). Default integer.

max_limit.description: Most rows one fetch or search returns. Default 1000.

default_order.description: Field names (comma-separated) reads sort by when the caller passes no order_by.

slug.description: URL segment of the model's routes, e.g. "articles" mounts /articles/fetch. Defaults to the model name.

access.description: Who may call each operation, with optional row-level conditions. When present, access is denied by default: an operation that is not listed returns 403. Keys are operation names (fetch, search, count, exists, create, update, upsert, delete, destroy, restore); the special key "fields" holds field-level read/write rules.

fields.description: Field-level security, by field name. A listed field is readable/writable only by the listed roles; an empty list means nobody. Fields not listed are unrestricted.

additionalProperties.description: Roles allowed to read and write one field.

read.description: Roles that may read the field. Empty list: nobody.

write.description: Roles that may write the field. Empty list: nobody.

write_error.description: A create, update or upsert that sends this field from a role that may not write it is refused with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR and this message, instead of the field being skipped. Use it to point callers to the flow that does change the field.

additionalProperties.description: Rules for one operation. A caller is allowed when any rule matches its role (and its condition, if any).

rate_limit.description: Per-model API rate limiting. Three forms: flat, applying to every operation ({"max_requests": 100, "window_seconds": 60, "per": "ip"}); per operation, with "default" as the fallback ({"default": {...}, "create": {...}}); or opt-out ({"enabled": false}). Absent or {} inherits the kirak.json default. Do not mix the flat and per-operation forms.

enabled.description: false turns rate limiting off for this model. Absent or true keeps it on.

max_requests.description: Flat form: requests allowed per window. Required when any flat key is set.

window_seconds.description: Flat form: length of the window, in seconds.

per.description: Flat form: what the counter is kept per: the client IP, the signed-in user, or the whole model.

default.description: Per-operation form: limit for operations without their own entry.

cache.description: Per-model Redis caching of fetch, search, count and exists. Model-level only. Absent inherits kirak.json's cache settings; needs KIRAK_REDIS_URL.

enabled.description: true caches this model's reads; false opts out even when kirak.json enables caching. Absent inherits kirak.json's cache.enabled.

ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a cached result is served before the database is queried again. Absent inherits kirak.json's cache.default_ttl_seconds.

indexes.description: Database indexes beyond the automatic primary key and unique-field indexes. Each entry creates one CREATE INDEX or CREATE UNIQUE INDEX statement. Use for columns that appear in WHERE clauses, access conditions, or ORDER BY but do not need a uniqueness constraint.

columns.description: Column names to index, in order. One entry for a single-column index; two or more for a composite index.

unique.description: If true, CREATE UNIQUE INDEX is emitted. For single-column uniqueness, prefer unique: true on the field (it also enforces uniqueness at the application level).

identifier.description: A plain SQL identifier: letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit.

fields.description: Field definitions, by field name. Names are plain SQL identifiers.

field.description: One field: its type and constraints. Unknown properties are rejected, so a misspelled one is not silently ignored.

type.description: Data type. string VARCHAR(max_length, default 255); text TEXT; integer; float; decimal DECIMAL(precision, scale); boolean; timestamp; datetime; date; uuid (a UUID, stored and returned as a 36-character string); json (object or list); email (validated address); file and image (a path or URL); multiselect (a list, stored as JSON).

required.description: Reject create and update when the field is missing or null. Default false.

unique.description: Reject a create or update that would duplicate an existing value. Default false.

searchable.description: Include the field in search queries. Only string, text and email fields are searched. Default false.

sortable.description: Allow the field in order_by. Default true; with false, a request that sorts by it is refused (400).

label.description: Human-readable name used in validation error messages instead of the field key.

description.description: What the field holds. Shown in the error message when pattern does not match.

primary_key.description: Mark the field as the primary key. Only for custom primary keys; Kirak adds id by default.

auto_increment.description: Make a custom integer primary key AUTO_INCREMENT (MySQL) or SERIAL (PostgreSQL).

default.description: Value used when a create request leaves the field out.

enum.description: Allowed values. Anything else is rejected on create and update; on a multiselect field every item must be one of them.

values.description: Informational list of values. Not enforced; use enum to restrict values.

max_length.description: Maximum length of a string or email value. Default 255.

min_length.description: string only: minimum length of the value.

pattern.description: string only: regular expression the value must match from its start (Python re.match).

min_value.description: integer and float only: smallest allowed value.

max_value.description: integer and float only: largest allowed value.

on_update.description: CURRENT_TIMESTAMP sets the field to the current time on every create and update.

precision.description: decimal only: total number of digits, e.g. 10 in DECIMAL(10, 2).

scale.description: decimal only: digits after the decimal point, e.g. 2 in DECIMAL(10, 2). Must not exceed precision.

foreign_key.description: Marks the field as a reference to another model. Set together with relationship.

relationship.description: The model and field this foreign key points to. GraphQL uses it to join the related model.

foreign_key.description: Field of the related model this field matches, usually id.

access_rule.description: One access rule: a role, and optionally a row-level condition.

role.description: Role the rule applies to, as in the caller's token. "*" matches everyone, including callers who are not signed in; an exact role match takes precedence over "*".

condition.description: Row-level filter: a SQL WHERE fragment whose {placeholders} are filled from the caller's token claims and always sent as parameters. Operators: =, !=, <>, <, >, <=, >=, IS NULL, IS NOT NULL, LIKE, joined by AND or OR. Checked at startup.

rate_limit_rule.description: A rate limit for one operation.

window_seconds.description: Length of the window, in seconds.

per.description: What the counter is kept per: the client IP, the signed-in user, or the whole model.
